text: Commercial real estate non-performing loans increased to 2.6% from 1.8%, primarily within the office portfolio. The allowance for credit losses increased 14%, compared with total loan growth of 4%.
Refinancing pressure may intensify where collateral values and occupancy remain below pre-2023 levels. Office exposure is concentrated in three metropolitan markets with slower leasing activity.
Uninsured deposits declined by 7% while average wholesale funding increased by 11%. The liquidity coverage ratio remained above the internal limit throughout the year.
The bank completed a core-platform migration during the fourth quarter. No material outage occurred, although elevated manual reconciliation continued for six weeks after conversion.
Assets under management increased 6% to $418 billion. Net outflows in active equities partially offset market appreciation across the broader platform.
Performance fee revenue remains dependent on a limited number of alternative investment strategies. Two strategies generated 63% of performance fees in 2025.
Liquidity buffers covered modeled redemptions under the severe internal scenario. Private-market funds retain contractual gates that limit forced asset sales during stress.
Northstar relies on third-party administrators for fund accounting in several jurisdictions. Management expanded vendor resilience testing and recovery exercises during the year.
Transaction losses increased 21%, primarily reflecting account-takeover activity and higher cross-border volume. Payment volume increased 13% during the same period.
A significant interruption at either primary processing partner could delay transaction authorization. Two external processors handle most authorization traffic.
Management accelerated investment in identity controls, behavioral fraud models, and incident response. Automated step-up verification now covers 82% of high-risk login events.
Cross-border revenue is exposed to foreign-exchange volatility. The company uses rolling forward contracts to hedge a portion of forecast net currency exposure.
